layout.direction: Right-facing front three-quarter; runtime may flip horizontally.
layout.source_spacing: The generator produced six columns and six action rows with nonuniform spacing. Runtime explicit source regions and a fixed virtual canvas/ground anchor are required; do not slice by equal normalized row bounds.
layout.scale_rule: Use one fixed actor scale across all frames. Pose frames are redrawn, not procedural rotation, squash, recolor, or synthetic in-between warps.

visual_validation: All six actions and all six frames per row inspected visually.
Walk frames show alternating planted feet and passing knees.
Attack frames progress from low guard to overhead anticipation, horizontal contact, follow-through, recovery and guard.
Dodge, hurt and defeat include distinct redrawn limb and expression poses.
Padding revisions isolate complete figures and sword tips from neighboring poses.
Herbal basket and performance drum moved to back/hip to free sword hand.
source_policy: Packaged PNGs are byte-identical to image_gen outputs. Original and padding revision outputs remain in /workspace/generated_images. Read-only alpha analysis identifies frame gaps; no Python or other image pixel editing was used.
limitations: One viewing direction with horizontal mirroring; no independent back-facing animations.
Six frames per action; transition and timing are controlled by gameplay simulation.
Generated source spacing is not perfectly uniform; calibration metadata must be included when exporting.
